'''Foundry''' was a planet in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].

==History==
Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Foundry was one of many worlds used by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] to manufacture [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]]. Its workers designed the powerful [[B3 ultra battle droid]]. It was one of five places where such production was stopped by the Techno Union to give the illusion battle droids were no longer being produced, whereas in reality such droids were being mass-produced in secret [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] facilities such as [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. The planet was rich in the [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] [[hfredium]], [[Kammris/Legends|kammris]] and [[Dolovite/Legends|dolovite]]: metals vital in construction of [[Starship/Legends|starships]], as well as for the construction of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]], [[ceraglass]], and [[Chromium/Legends|chromium]].

[[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor's]] private estate was located on the planet, in the city [[Denus]].

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] later used the planet to manufacture [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and experimental [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. The ''[[Staraker]]'' was [[Mission to Foundry|stolen]] by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on this planet.

By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the planet had become an Imperial [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]. Foundry and nearby [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] were abandoned by the Empire in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], when [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces moved to the Colonies from the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]].<ref name="TEA" />
